title: Drill presses
subtitle: Gear-head drill presses 1 – 2″ in steel with power feed and tapping · TX530 inverter drill presses · TB belt-drive and stepless column drills
about_title: Drill presses for the fabrication and maintenance shop
about_text: NovoTech's value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification by a maker that exports metalworking machinery to more than 70 countries, inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name with a CSA-approved panel on every 3-phase machine, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada.

A drill press holds the drill square to the work and feeds it with the force and control a hand drill cannot give. The gear-head drill presses change speed through a gearbox — no belts to move — with the torque for large holes and tapping, from 1″ to 2″ in steel; the TX530 runs on a frequency inverter with a two-range gearbox; the TB column drills have a V-belt drive, or stepless speed by frequency converter on single-phase power.
